_why: Alder ships a live backend. Two of the evidence strings below used to describe the pre-backend prototype ('the client is the store of record', 'the only outbound URL is findtreatment.gov') and that stale evidence is what let index.html publish 'no server' and a future-tense chat sentence unchallenged. Evidence here is re-derived from alder-app/alder-api on 2026-08-06; the authority for any sentence about where Alder's data goes is alder-app/app-claims-contract.json, not this file.

evidence: recovery-companion-PLAN.md: v1 is accountless. There is no name, email, or password anywhere in the product, and no sign-in surface in the client.

alder-app/api.js deviceId(): a caller is identified to the backend by a locally minted random `alder.deviceId` plus an entitlement header — never by a personal identifier. The backend rows are keyed to that random id and nothing else.
recovery-companion-PLAN.md §2: 'No ads or third-party marketing/analytics SDKs, ever; never sell/share data.'

A grep of alder-app app.js / api.js / both HTML sources for Google Analytics, GTM, gtag, Firebase, Sentry, Mixpanel, Amplitude, AppsFlyer, Segment, Facebook, DoubleClick and AdMob returns nothing. This claim is pinned by must_not_match invariants in alder-app/app-claims-contract.json, so a tracker fails the build.

no_server.why: Alder HAS a server and the site must never say otherwise. alder-app/api.js:126 `export const BACKEND_LIVE = true`; api.js:131 PROD_HOST = 'alder-api.fly.dev'; app.js:874-921 sends the profile slice (name, tone, per-target quit dates, reasons, people's first names, dependence flags, last seven check-ins) on every turn; alder-api persists companion_conversations / messages / memories / safety_logs (alder-api/app/companion/models.py:102,178,236,294). What IS true, and is what privacy.html says, is narrower: no recovery-record database on our side, and 30-day retention on the conversation.

chat_not_yet_live.why: Conversations are live. Any future-tense sentence about Alder's chat ('when conversations go live', 'will be sent to a named AI provider') is stale. The provider is Anthropic and only Anthropic: this deployment holds no OpenAI key and COMPANION_LLM_FAILOVER_ENABLED is false (alder-app/ios/App/App/public/index-onboarding.html:275-282). Naming a second provider is over-disclosure and equally inaccurate.

nothing_for_sale.why: Alder Plus ships: com.hypersage.alder.plus.monthly / .annual (alder-app/ios/App/App/AlderPlus.swift:31-32) at US$9.99/month and US$59.99/year, which terms.html:78 and support.html:122 already quoted while index.html denied any price existed.
